overview: Danube lists 956 apartments and 102 levels. Its internal 30 September 2026 update reports 17% progress, shoring and piling completed, with excavation and strut installation continuing. This is a dated developer report, not confirmation of completion.
research.locationNote: Business Bay, on the developer’s Al Mustaqbal Street map. Confirm the selected orientation and surrounding construction.
research.priceNote: The current headline is AED 2.4m, while the same page’s FAQ retains a studio guide of AED 1.27m. Property Finder carries an older launch guide. These snapshots do not establish current entry stock.
research.paymentNote: The developer now advertises 30/70 without a dated calendar. Property Finder and the broker summary instead describe 10% booking, 59% construction, 1% completion and 30% post-handover. The broker sheet spreads the final 30% over 30 months. Confirm the contract; the schedules are not treated as equivalent.
research.handoverNote: The developer headline targets June 2029, its FAQ says December 2028, and Property Finder says December 2029. None establishes actual handover; the conflict needs written clarification.
unresolved: Areas include balconies. Penthouse totals cover both levels; printed totals are not doubled. Layout variants differ from older portal ranges.
Convertible marketing labels do not automatically change the registered bedroom count. Confirm the executed plan and furnishing inventory.

Helipad and sky-taxi imagery does not confirm operational approvals or available services. Current stock, charges, parking, final milestones and completion documents remain unverified. Images remain illustrative.
